entries.name: Not subscribed, in the app

entries.name: 02 explored: brand, buttons, small print
entries.note: The no-card frame taken forward. Where the brand lives (above the title, on it, in the header, at the foot), with 44px buttons in a 360 column and the small print at the screen's foot; both levers overridable.

entries.name: The auth frame: card, page and brand
entries.note: Sign-up and sign-in in two steps (Google, Apple, Continue with email; then the email form with a back arrow) under three frames: the card on desktop only, no card at any width as Create circle, and the brand on step 1 only. Posture from canon's Config (Platform, Viewport); each page reads whether it fits.

entries.name: Proposal: email on request, on today's pages
entries.note: The shipped card and rhythm in two steps: Google, Apple and Continue with email, then the email form alone with a back arrow. Sign-up and sign-in on a phone screen.

entries.name: Fitting sign-up on one phone screen
entries.note: Seven versions of the auth pages, sign-up and sign-in side by side, measured at five screens' visible heights: today, less air, fewer lines, Google and Apple first, email on request (and its form taking the buttons' place), everything at its floor. One page each, no wizard.

entries.name: The Subscription card's three acts
entries.note: Three arrangements of Update, Switch and Cancel on the Account card, in every state at 320, 390 and desktop: one shape, pair and a foot, each act beside its fact. Plus Subscribe as a button or in the line.

entries.name: The subscription page, on a phone
entries.note: Three ways to say the free month, the yearly saving and the card terms: receipt, the offer under the heading, timeline. 01.1 and 01.2 refine the receipt; 01.2 is built into the candidate at every width.

entries.name: The subscription page, on desktop
entries.note: Three layouts at 1280: centred column, centred with plans side by side, two columns with one panel. Settled by the phone board's 01.2, built as the centred column.

entries.name: The Switch plan overlay
entries.note: The switch confirm as a bottom sheet at 320 and 390 and a centred modal on desktop, over the real card: one sentence, the card's own rows, the saving as the sentence.

entries.name: The Subscription card when lapsed

entries.name: The Cancel subscription overlay
entries.note: Bodies for the cancel confirm, active and free month, sheet and modal. 02.4 chosen, built in.

entries.name: Taking over and creating while your subscription is ending
entries.note: The candidate, framed, with three answers to the gate: fix first on the screen, fix in the take-over sheet, fix on the button. Each covers take-over and the New circle form, for Ending and Payment failed. Take-over 1 and create 3 chosen, built in.

entries.name: The Account card on Payment failed

entries.note: One subscription per person covers every circle they run; members free. /subscribe in two states (one centred column, receipt rows), Create through pricing, the Account card in four states, take-over and the step-back line. Walk it from QA in the launcher.

entries.name: Clearing restores the title
